On Tue, Apr 19, 2027 at 10:03 AM marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com wrote:
> Kimberly — quick heads up from Finance: the registrar confirmation Elena sent does not match the EIN format we have on file and flags a mismatch during our AP vendor-matching process. We need a secondary verification (bank letter or government tax office notice) before we can approve the PO.

Marcus is right — for international entities we accept any of the following as satisfactory evidence:

- Bank-issued letter on bank letterhead confirming tax ID/EIN, OR
- Notice of Tax Registration from the vendor's national tax authority, OR
- A notarized affidavit from the vendor certifying the tax number plus a secondary corroborating document (bank letter preferred).

Once we have one of those, Finance can unfreeze the PO. Please ask Novum to provide the bank letter if available — it usually clears faster than requesting a government notice.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
